business_summary: Changzhou Langbo Sealing Technologies Co.,Ltd. produces and sells rubber seals and rubber products in China and internationally. The company provides auto turbo tubes, automotive fuel system seals, auto gearbox fuel tank, auto engine oil seals, automobile brake system rubber parts, automotive brake booster rubber parts, automotive lamp system rubber parts, automobile power steering system rubber parts, automotive brake main cylinder seals, automotive air conditioning rubber parts, and automotive air conditioning compressor seal parts. It also provides railway sleeper pads, bogie system flexible positioning sleeves, and motor air duct rubber parts; engineering machinery rubber products; and aviation series rubber products. Changzhou Langbo Sealing Technologies Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Changzhou, China.
